channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – Metrics
channel.description: Recent metrics posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 10/17: Alarms & Incident Triage
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 10 of the Meet Horizon UI series: the incident-centric active-alarms surface — re-fires merged into one row, the MQE snapshot that fired a rule replayed on a single chart, and the same incident model carried across the topbar badge, dashboards, and the 3D map.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 11/17: Runtime Rules & Live Debugging
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 11 of the Meet Horizon UI series: edit SkyWalking's OAL/MAL/LAL analysis rules in the browser and hot-apply them to the running cluster with a fenced, recoverable rollout — then step those same rules against live data in the three-tab Live Debugger to see exactly what they compute.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 12/17: Inspect — Cross-Layer Query Power-Tools
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 12 of the Meet Horizon UI series: the Inspect family under Operate — a metric catalog and MQE board that shows which rule defines every metric, plus layer-less trace and log finders that query across the whole deployment without picking a layer first.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 10/17：告警与 Incident 排查
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十篇：活跃告警不再按事件堆叠，而是按 incident 归并；触发规则时的 MQE 指标快照可以直接回放，同一套 incident 模型也会出现在顶栏、仪表盘和 3D 地图里。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 11/17：运行时规则与实时调试
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十一篇：在浏览器里编辑 SkyWalking 的 OAL/MAL/LAL 分析规则，通过可恢复的集群确认流程让变更在运行中的 OAP 上生效；再用三个标签页的 Live Debugger 让同一条规则跑在真实数据上，看清它到底算出了什么。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 12/17：Inspect，跨 layer 查询工具
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十二篇：Operate 下的 Inspect 家族，包括能看到每个指标由哪条规则定义的指标目录和 MQE 看板，以及不必先选择 layer 就能在全局范围查询的 trace 和 log 入口。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 2/17: Dashboards That Adapt — MQE, Smart Widgets, and Numbers Humans Can Read
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 2 of the Horizon UI series: how its dashboards are built from MQE expressions, hide the widgets that don't apply to the entity in front of you (skipping their queries on the server), and render OK instead of 1 and 45.1k instead of 4.51e4.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 2/17：动态仪表盘、MQE 与指标格式化
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第二篇：仪表盘如何由 MQE 表达式驱动，如何按当前服务、实例或 endpoint 自动取舍组件并跳过无关查询，以及如何把编码值、耗时和大数值格式化成适合排查时阅读的样子。

item.title: Monitoring WeChat and Alipay Mini Programs with SkyWalking
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: SkyAPM/mini-program-monitor and SkyWalking OAP together extend SkyWalking's end-user monitoring to WeChat and Alipay Mini Programs. This post focuses on the data path, the cross-platform abstraction, and the OAP-side integration.

item.title: Query SkyWalking and Zipkin Traces with TraceQL and Visualize in Grafana
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: SkyWalking 10.4 introduces TraceQL support, implementing Grafana Tempo's HTTP query APIs so that Grafana can query and visualize traces stored in SkyWalking.

item.title: 使用 TraceQL 查询 SkyWalking 和 Zipkin 链路追踪数据并在 Grafana 中可视化
item.dc:creator: 万凯
item.description: SkyWalking 10.4 引入了 TraceQL 支持，实现了 Grafana Tempo 的 HTTP 查询 API，使 Grafana 可以直接查询和可视化 SkyWalking 中存储的链路追踪数据。

item.title: Monitoring LLM Applications with SkyWalking 10.4: Insights into Performance and Cost
item.dc:creator: YiMing Shao
item.description: SkyWalking 10.4 introduces the Virtual GenAI dashboard. This article explores how to use this new feature to monitor and optimize LLM integrations.

item.title: Monitoring Flink with SkyWalking
item.dc:creator: YiMing Shao
item.description: SkyWalking 10.3 introduces a new Flink monitoring dashboard, and this article will demonstrate the usage of this monitoring dashboard.

item.title: Build Grafana dashboards for Apache SkyWalking -- Native PromQL Support
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: Introduce what is PromQL Service in SkyWalking and how to use it to build Grafana dashboards.

item.title: 为 Apache SkyWalking 构建 Grafana Dashboard —— 原生 PromQL 支持
item.dc:creator: 万凯
item.description: 本文介绍什么是 SkyWalking 中的 PromQL 服务，以及如何使用它来构建 Grafana Dashboard。

item.title: eBPF enhanced HTTP observability - L7 metrics and tracing
item.dc:creator: Han Liu, Sheng Wu
item.description: This article will show how to use Apache SkyWalking with eBPF to enhance metrics and traces in HTTP observability.

item.title: 使用 eBPF 提升 HTTP 可观测性 - L7 指标和追踪
item.dc:creator: 刘晗，吴晟
item.description: 本文将展示如何使用 Apache SkyWalking 与 eBPF 来增强 HTTP 观察性中的度量和追踪。

item.title: Boost Root Cause Analysis Quickly With SkyWalking’s New Trace-Metrics Association Feature
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: SkyWalking 9.3.0 introduced the new capability that help you visualize the connection between traces and corresponding metrics quickly.

item.title: SkyWalking 推出 trace-metric 关联功能助力快速根源问题排查
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: SkyWalking 9.3.0 引入了新功能，可视化 trace 和相应 metric 之间的联系，帮助您快速实现问题诊断。
